sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Salaries of certain public officers to be charged on the Consolidated Fund
maudhui: (1) Public officers to whom this Article applies shall be paid such salaries and allowances as may be prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament. (2) Salaries and allowances payable to public officers to whom this Article applies, together with pensions and gratuities payable to those entitled to them, shall be charged upon the Consolidated Fund. (3) The salary and terms of service of a public officer to whom this Article applies shall not, after appointment, be altered to his disadvantage, but this provision shall not apply to allowances. (4) Where a public officer to whom this Article applies has an option concerning the rate of salary or terms of service, the salary rate and terms selected shall, for purposes of subarticle (3), be regarded as more advantageous than any other rate or terms that could have been selected. (5) This Article applies to a Justice of Appeal, a Judge of the High Court of the United Republic, the Chairman and every member of the Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance, and the Controller and Auditor-General of the United Republic.
